overview: The Noble Terrace is home to Sanctus Seru’s elite officials, Praetorian commanders, and doctrinal authorities.
history: Constructed to house Seru’s earliest magistrates and Praetorian elite.
Purity-screened estates were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Ceremonial terraces were introduced to reinforce imperial prestige.
Arcane-lit courtyards became symbols of noble status.
hooks: A noble estate reports a purity ward destabilization.
A ceremonial courtyard’s arcane lights pulse irregularly.
A Praetorian honor guard requests assistance with a noble edict.
A high-ranking magistrate disappears under suspicious circumstances.
